comment: Scope: r=5, at rest. c3-c5 replicated by independent lab-c runs (not lab-a). Fits: signed K, P=2.5 fixed, 1-D projection onto the pair axis, tracker residual rms 0.049-0.052. B-C (023, diagonal): K_B(C)=-6.32 (paper -6.10, +3.6%), K_C(B)=-10.20 (paper -10.59, -3.7%). C-C (024, vertical): 12.63, 12.39 (mean 12.51 vs 12.36, +1.2%). B-B (025, anti-diagonal): 6.22, 6.34 (mean 6.28 vs 6.12, +2.6%). Deviations are inside the run-level spread the paper reports. c1 (A-B) and c2 (A-C): no independent two-body run at r=5 from me. Jointly, the triangle 020 (A,B,C at side 5) matches the pairwise-additive prediction from the P-0005 values at tracker noise (rms 0.051 per coordinate over 600 samples). A 20% error in K_C(A) would shift the t=2 displacement by about 0.15, three times the noise, so 020 constrains A-B and A-C jointly. It does not identify them separately. My earlier r=4 A-C A-side mismatch (2026-11-18/r1/lab-c/008) is outside the stated domain and is not used here. This replaces my earlier 'inconclusive' verdict, which lacked independent runs for c3-c5.
